<script>
const defaults=['Wake up on time','Study / Learn','Exercise','Drink enough water','Eat healthy food','Organize your space','Finish an important task','Learn something new','Spend time with family','Go to bed on time'];
const key='change-life-v1';let data={days:{},diamonds:0,messages:[]};try{const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key));if(s&&s.days)data=s}catch(e){}if(!Array.isArray(data.messages))data.messages=[];
let selected=new Date();selected.setHours(12,0,0,0);let calMonth=new Date(selected.getFullYear(),selected.getMonth(),1),chartMonth=selected.getMonth(),flowMonth=selected.getMonth();
const months=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
function dateId(d){return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`}
function getDay(d){let k=dateId(d);if(!data.days[k])data.days[k]={tasks:defaults.map((name,i)=>({id:i+1,name,done:false}))};return data.days[k]}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(data));}catch(e){alert('Could not save in this browser. Please allow local storage and try again.');}}
function rate(d){let a=getDay(d).tasks;if(!a.length)return 0;return a.filter(t=>t.done).length/a.length*100}
function renderHeader(){let d=new Date();document.getElementById('todayDate').innerHTML=`<strong>${['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'][d.getDay()]}</strong>${months[d.getMonth()]} ${d.getDate()}, ${d.getFullYear()}`}
function totalDiamonds(){return Object.values(data.days).reduce((sum,day)=>sum+(day.tasks||[]).filter(t=>t.done).length,0)}
function renderProgress(){let a=getDay(selected).tasks,done=a.filter(t=>t.done).length,p=a.length?Math.round(done/a.length*100):0;document.getElementById('progressPercent').textContent=p+'%';document.getElementById('progressCount').textContent=done+' of '+a.length+' completed';document.getElementById('progressFill').style.width=p+'%';document.getElementById('doneCount').textContent=done;document.getElementById('leftCount').textContent=a.length-done;document.getElementById('taskTotal').textContent=a.length+' goals';document.getElementById('diamondBalance').textContent=totalDiamonds()}
function renderTasks(){let a=getDay(selected).tasks,el=document.getElementById('tasks');el.innerHTML='';a.forEach(t=>{let row=document.createElement('div');row.className='task'+(t.done?' done':'');row.setAttribute('role','button');row.tabIndex=0;let name=document.createElement('div');name.className='taskname';name.textContent=t.name;let diamond=document.createElement('span');diamond.className='diamond';diamond.textContent='◆';diamond.setAttribute('aria-label','Reward diamond');let edit=document.createElement('button');edit.className='edit';edit.textContent='EDIT';edit.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();let v=prompt('Edit task:',t.name);if(v!==null&&v.trim()){t.name=v.trim();save();render()}};let toggle=()=>{t.done=!t.done;save();render()};row.onclick=toggle;row.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();toggle()}};row.append(name,diamond,edit);el.append(row)})}
function renderCalendar(){let y=calMonth.getFullYear(),m=calMonth.getMonth(),first=new Date(y,m,1),offset=(first.getDay()+1)%7,days=new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();document.getElementById('calendarMonth').textContent=months[m]+' '+y;let el=document.getElementById('calendar');el.innerHTML='';['Sat','Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri'].forEach(x=>{let c=document.createElement('div');c.className='cal-cell head';c.textContent=x;el.append(c)});for(let i=0;i<offset;i++){let c=document.createElement('div');c.className='cal-cell';el.append(c)}for(let n=1;n<=days;n++){let d=new Date(y,m,n,12),c=document.createElement('button');c.className='cal-cell';c.style.border='0';c.style.background='transparent';c.style.cursor='pointer';if(dateId(d)===dateId(new Date()))c.classList.add('today');if(dateId(d)===dateId(selected))c.classList.add('selected');let saved=data.days[dateId(d)];let completed=saved?(saved.tasks||[]).filter(t=>t.done).length:0;if(completed)c.classList.add('hasdata');c.innerHTML='<span class="cal-number">'+n+'</span>'+(completed?'<span class="cal-lines">'+Array.from({length:Math.min(completed,8)},()=>'<i></i>').join('')+'</span>':'');c.onclick=()=>{selected=d;chartMonth=d.getMonth();flowMonth=d.getMonth();calMonth=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),1);render()};el.append(c)}}
function canvasSetup(id){let c=document.getElementById(id),r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),ratio=devicePixelRatio||1;c.width=Math.max(1,r.width*ratio);c.height=Math.max(1,r.height*ratio);let x=c.getContext('2d');x.setTransform(ratio,0,0,ratio,0,0);return {c,x,w:r.width,h:r.height}}

function drawFlow(){
 let area=document.querySelector('.flow-area'),c=document.getElementById('flowChart');
 const days=new Date(selected.getFullYear(),flowMonth+1,0).getDate(),left=18,right=18,slot=42;
 let plotWidth=left+right+days*slot;
 c.style.width=Math.max(area.clientWidth,plotWidth)+'px';c.style.height='100%';
 let {x,w,h}=canvasSetup('flowChart');x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let y=selected.getFullYear(),m=flowMonth;
 let vals=Array.from({length:days},(_,i)=>rate(new Date(y,m,i+1,12)));
 let l=18,r=18,t=18,b=35,ph=h-t-b,pw=w-l-r;
 for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
  let yy=t+ph*(i/4);
  x.strokeStyle='#373123';x.lineWidth=1;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(l,yy);x.lineTo(w-r,yy);x.stroke();
 }
 let step=pw/(days-1),pts=vals.map((v,i)=>({x:l+i*step,y:t+ph*(1-v/100)}));
 x.lineWidth=3;x.lineJoin='round';x.lineCap='round';
 for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){
  let rising=vals[i]>=vals[i-1],color=rising?'#24c875':'#e34b4b';
  x.beginPath();x.strokeStyle=color;x.shadowColor=rising?'transparent':'#e34b4b';
  x.shadowBlur=rising?0:7;x.moveTo(pts[i-1].x,pts[i-1].y);x.lineTo(pts[i].x,pts[i].y);x.stroke();
 }
 x.shadowBlur=0;
 pts.forEach((p,i)=>{
  x.beginPath();x.fillStyle=i===0?'#24c875':(vals[i]>=vals[i-1]?'#24c875':'#e34b4b');
  x.arc(p.x,p.y,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  x.fillStyle='#d8c69e';x.font='10px system-ui';x.textAlign='center';x.fillText(String(i+1),p.x,h-11);
 });
}

function makeMonthTabs(id,active,onPick){
 let el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;el.innerHTML='';
 months.forEach((m,i)=>{let b=document.createElement('button');b.className='month-tab'+(i===active?' active':'');b.textContent=m;b.onclick=()=>onPick(i);el.append(b)});
}
function renderMonthTabs(){
 makeMonthTabs('monthTabs',chartMonth,i=>{chartMonth=i;renderMonthTabs();drawMonth()});
 makeMonthTabs('calendarMonthTabs',calMonth.getMonth(),i=>{calMonth.setMonth(i);renderCalendar();renderMonthTabs()});
 makeMonthTabs('flowMonthTabs',flowMonth,i=>{flowMonth=i;renderMonthTabs();drawFlow()});
 makeMonthTabs('pieMonthTabs',selected.getMonth(),i=>{let day=selected.getDate(),year=selected.getFullYear(),max=new Date(year,i+1,0).getDate();selected=new Date(year,i,Math.min(day,max),12);calMonth=new Date(year,i,1);render();document.querySelector('[data-tab=\"pie\"]').click()});
}

function drawMonth(){
 let c=document.getElementById('monthChart'),area=document.getElementById('monthChartScroll');
 let y=selected.getFullYear();
 const days=new Date(y,chartMonth+1,0).getDate(),left=18,right=18,slot=42;
 let baseWidth=Math.max(area.clientWidth,left+right+days*slot);
 c.style.width=baseWidth+'px';c.style.height='100%';
 let {x,w,h}=canvasSetup('monthChart');x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
 let vals=Array.from({length:days},(_,i)=>getDay(new Date(y,chartMonth,i+1,12)).tasks.filter(t=>t.done).length);
 let totals=Array.from({length:days},(_,i)=>Math.max(1,getDay(new Date(y,chartMonth,i+1,12)).tasks.length));
 let rates=vals.map((v,i)=>v/totals[i]*100);
 let l=18,r=18,t=22,b=35,ph=h-t-b,pw=w-l-r,step=pw/days,bw=Math.min(25,step*.58);
 for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
  let yy=t+ph*(i/4);
  x.strokeStyle='#342f23';x.lineWidth=1;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(l,yy);x.lineTo(w-r,yy);x.stroke();
 }
 vals.forEach((count,i)=>{
  let pct=rates[i],barH=ph*pct/100,px=l+i*step+(step-bw)/2,py=t+ph-barH;
  const rising = i===0 ? true : count>=vals[i-1];
  const barColor = rising ? '#24c875' : '#e34b4b';
  x.fillStyle=barColor;x.shadowColor=barColor;x.shadowBlur=count?9:0;
  x.fillRect(px,py,bw,barH);x.shadowBlur=0;
  x.fillStyle='#ffd36b';x.shadowColor='#ffc84d';x.shadowBlur=14;
  x.font='900 12px system-ui';x.textAlign='center';
  if(count>0)x.fillText(String(count),px+bw/2,Math.max(t+13,py-7));
  x.shadowBlur=0;
  x.fillStyle='#d8c69e';x.font='10px system-ui';x.fillText(String(i+1),px+bw/2,h-11);
 });
}


function drawPie(){
 let c=document.getElementById('pieChart');if(!c)return;
 let rect=c.getBoundingClientRect(),ratio=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
 c.width=Math.max(1,rect.width*ratio);c.height=Math.max(1,rect.height*ratio);
 let x=c.getContext('2d');x.setTransform(ratio,0,0,ratio,0,0);
 let tasks=getDay(selected).tasks,done=tasks.filter(t=>t.done).length,left=tasks.length-done,total=Math.max(1,tasks.length);
 let cx=rect.width/2,cy=rect.height/2,r=Math.min(rect.width,rect.height)*.38,start=-Math.PI/2;
 [[done,'#d9a62e'],[left,'#3d3525']].forEach(([v,color])=>{let end=start+Math.PI*2*v/total;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(cx,cy);x.arc(cx,cy,r,start,end);x.closePath();x.fillStyle=color;x.fill();start=end});
 x.fillStyle='#fff';x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';x.font='900 25px system-ui';x.fillText(Math.round(done/total*100)+'%',cx,cy-3);
 x.font='12px system-ui';x.fillStyle='#d8c69e';x.fillText(done+' / '+tasks.length+' done',cx,cy+20);
}
function renderPieDays(){
 const el=document.getElementById('pieDays');if(!el)return;el.innerHTML='';
 const days=new Date(selected.getFullYear(),selected.getMonth()+1,0).getDate();
 for(let d=1;d<=days;d++){
  const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='pie-day'+(d===selected.getDate()?' active':'');b.textContent=d;
  b.onclick=()=>{selected=new Date(selected.getFullYear(),selected.getMonth(),d,12);calMonth=new Date(selected.getFullYear(),selected.getMonth(),1);render();document.querySelector('[data-tab="pie"]').click();};
  el.append(b);
 }
 const active=el.querySelector('.active');if(active)active.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'center'});
}
function renderMessages(){
 const list=document.getElementById('messageList');if(!list)return;list.innerHTML='';
 if(!data.messages.length){let empty=document.createElement('p');empty.className='message-empty';empty.textContent='No saved messages yet. Press ＋ to add your first message.';list.append(empty);return;}
 data.messages.forEach((msg,index)=>{let card=document.createElement('article');card.className='saved-message';let body=document.createElement('p');body.textContent=msg.text;let footer=document.createElement('div');footer.className='saved-message-footer';let date=document.createElement('small');date.textContent=msg.date||'Saved message';let actions=document.createElement('div');let edit=document.createElement('button');edit.textContent='Edit';edit.onclick=()=>openMessageEditor(index);let del=document.createElement('button');del.textContent='Delete';del.onclick=()=>{data.messages.splice(index,1);save();renderMessages();};actions.append(edit,del);footer.append(date,actions);card.append(body,footer);list.append(card);});
}
function openMessageEditor(index=null){let editor=document.getElementById('messageEditor'),input=document.getElementById('messageInput');editor.hidden=false;editor.dataset.editIndex=index===null?'':String(index);input.value=index===null?'':data.messages[index].text;input.focus();}
function setupMessages(){
 document.getElementById('addMessage').onclick=()=>openMessageEditor();
 document.getElementById('cancelMessage').onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('messageEditor').hidden=true;};
 document.getElementById('saveMessage').onclick=()=>{let input=document.getElementById('messageInput'),value=input.value.trim();if(!value){input.focus();return;}let idx=document.getElementById('messageEditor').dataset.editIndex;if(idx==='')data.messages.unshift({text:value,date:new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US')});else data.messages[Number(idx)].text=value;save();document.getElementById('messageEditor').hidden=true;renderMessages();};
 renderMessages();
}

function render(){renderHeader();renderProgress();renderTasks();renderCalendar();drawFlow();renderMonthTabs();drawMonth();drawPie();renderPieDays();renderMessages();document.getElementById('taskDate').textContent=selected.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{weekday:'long',month:'long',day:'numeric'})+' · Tasks'}
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));document.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active',p.id==='pane-'+b.dataset.tab));if(b.dataset.tab==='flow')drawFlow();if(b.dataset.tab==='chart')drawMonth();if(b.dataset.tab==='pie'){drawPie();renderPieDays();}if(b.dataset.tab==='message')renderMessages()});
document.getElementById('monthPrev').onclick=()=>{calMonth.setMonth(calMonth.getMonth()-1);renderCalendar();renderPieDays()};document.getElementById('monthNext').onclick=()=>{calMonth.setMonth(calMonth.getMonth()+1);renderCalendar();renderPieDays()};
drawMonth();setupMessages();
document.getElementById('addForm').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();let input=document.getElementById('newTask');if(input.value.trim()){getDay(selected).tasks.push({id:Date.now(),name:input.value.trim(),done:false});input.value='';save();render()}};
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{drawFlow();drawMonth()});render();
</script>
